name: Being Pregnant
overview: Scripture reveals the sacredness and divine purpose of pregnancy, portraying children as a heritage and reward from the Lord, as seen in Psalms 127:3. God’s intimate involvement in forming life within the womb is affirmed in Psalms 139:13 and Jeremiah 1:5, where He sanctifies and ordains individuals even before birth. The value and protection of the unborn are emphasized in Exodus 21:22, which prescribes consequences for harm caused to a pregnant woman and her child. Furthermore, Isaiah 49:15 highlights God’s unfailing compassion, likening His care for His people to a mother’s love for her child, underscoring the profound relational and covenantal significance of pregnancy in God’s plan.
